content.overview: Section 2(55) defines member as a subscriber, a person who agrees in writing and is entered in the register, or a person holding shares whose name is entered as beneficial owner in the depository records.

sections.heading: Explanation
sections.body: Entry in the register of members under s. 88, or the depository record, is central. Subscribers are members even before entry. Transfer does not make the transferee a member until registration. Minimum membership and the s. 3A consequence of falling below it should be kept distinct from the definition.
